lane: DISCOVERY -- development evidence only. No promotion. Arm D untouched. No arm_registry.jsonl write.
ledger_card_status: the frozen HYPOTHESIS_LEDGER.json card was NOT modified by this run
verdict: NULL on the registered primary metric (operational team MAE), with a preserved weak POSITIVE player-level finding in the hypothesised direction.

headline.registered_claim: a player-specific transfer form beats team-level displaced_involvement on operational team MAE
headline.outcome: NOT SUPPORTED as a team-MAE claim. All three constructions nominally beat the team-level H arm, but only because H is itself actively harmful. Against an honest intercept-only control, no construction improves operational team MAE.
headline.mechanism_signal: the direct (T1) and allocated (T2) forms carry a small, direction-correct, statistically clear PLAYER-level signal that does not survive aggregation to the team grain. The role-sensitive form (T3) is null even at the player level.

the_decisive_confound.name: free unpenalised intercept
the_decisive_confound.statement: Every fitted arm estimates an unpenalised intercept that Arm D does not have, so any arm can beat D purely by recalibrating the overall rate level. The registered comparison 'challenger vs D' therefore charges the mechanism for a gain that recalibration alone supplies.
the_decisive_confound.control_arm: K0 -- zero features, identical pipeline, intercept only
the_decisive_confound.implication: K0 alone accounts for the entire apparent team-MAE gain of T1 (+0.0023), T2 (+0.0025) and T3 (+0.0031) over D. Once K0 is the incumbent, every construction is indistinguishable from it.

operational_team_mae.note: the incumbent value 2.9675 reproduces the frozen ledger figure exactly

paired_team_mae_operational.convention: INCUMBENT abs error MINUS CHALLENGER abs error; POSITIVE = challenger beats incumbent; game-clustered percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, 90% CI, seed 20260730

vs_H.interpretation: the single CI exclusion (T3 vs H) is NOT evidence for the mechanism. H is worse than the do-nothing control K0 by -0.0040 [-0.0073,-0.0008], so beating H only says T3 avoids H's harm. It is also one marginal exclusion (lower bound +0.0001) among 28 registered comparisons, which is what multiplicity alone predicts.

player_level_operational_vs_K0.note: this is the grain at which the mechanism is expressed, and the only place it shows up
player_level_operational_vs_K0.reading: T2 (allocated displaced load) is the best construction: it beats the intercept-only control at the player grain with a CI clear of zero, while the team-level H arm is significantly WORSE than doing nothing. That is exactly the contrast the hypothesis predicted -- it is simply far too small to register on team MAE.

coefficient_evidence.claim: the fitted signs are stable and direction-correct across every walk-forward fold, which is stronger evidence for the mechanism than the MAE deltas are against it
observations: T1 and T2 are POSITIVE in all five fitted folds and grow monotonically as training support grows -- consistent with a real but small effect being estimated with increasing precision.
H is NEGATIVE in all five folds. The team-level displaced term points the WRONG way, which is why H underperforms the do-nothing control.

In the joint arm HT2 the two separate cleanly and offset: displaced_involvement runs -0.018 to -0.036 while transfer_allocated runs +0.019 to +0.035. The player-specific allocation is doing real work that the team-level term is not; but the offsetting pair is unstable out of sample, which is why HT2 has the WORST team MAE of any arm (2.9719).

effect size: a 1 SD increase in allocated displaced load raises the predicted turnover rate by roughly exp(0.019)-1 = 1.9 percent, about 0.02 turnovers for a typical player. Summed over a roster this is far inside the team-game noise floor.

why_the_null: MAGNITUDE, not direction. The mechanism is present and direction-correct but roughly two orders of magnitude smaller than the team-game error it is being asked to reduce. Operational team MAE is ~2.96 turnovers; the constructions move team totals by ~0.2 turnovers in absolute value and reduce error by ~0.003.

The metric is not blind to redistribution. This was tested and REJECTED as an explanation: the per-player perturbations ADD at the team grain rather than cancelling (cancellation ratio ~0.94-0.96, where 1.0 = pure addition). So the team metric can in principle see the effect; the effect is simply too small.

The registered comparison was miscalibrated. Comparing a fitted arm against unfitted Arm D conflates the mechanism with a free intercept. Both the original H null AND the apparent T-arm gains are dominated by that term.

The role-sensitive construction (T3) is the weakest, not the strongest. Multiplying allocated load by projected-role expansion zeroes 73 percent of rows (expansion is 0 for 71 percent of candidates) and shrinks the signal rather than sharpening it. The extra role weighting destroys more information than it adds.
failure_analysis.confounders_named_in_the_card: absences correlate with opponent quality and with the absent player's own rate. This run does not adjust for either; because the result is null on the primary metric, the confounders would only matter for interpreting the small player-level positive, and they plausibly inflate it.
failure_analysis.oracle_check: the intrinsic (realised-exposure) track shows the same pattern and no larger gain -- T2 vs K0 at player level +0.00128 [+0.00107,+0.00149], team level -0.0027 [-0.0080,+0.0022]. The finding is NOT an artefact of appearance conditioning, and the null does not hide behind the oracle track.

what_would_be_needed_to_revisit: re-run the whole P2/discovery comparison family against the K0 intercept-only control rather than against unfitted Arm D; several existing nulls and near-misses in this program are likely contaminated by the same free-intercept term
evaluate at the player grain, or on a team metric with a materially lower noise floor, since team-game MAE cannot resolve a 2 percent rate effect
if the transfer term is ever carried forward it should be T2 (allocated displaced load) alone; T1 is a noisier version of the same signal and T3 is null
disposition: NULL PRESERVED. Does not qualify as a challenger to Arm D. Recorded as development evidence only.
